items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Jimmy Strong and the Hite and Orendorff came here with this woman--this singer.

ctx.x: Jimmy Strong. Is that the one who came here with them?

That's...that's the one, yes. I was just trying to think of his name. Jimmy Strong and the Hite and Orendorff came here with this woman--this singer. I don't remember who her name was now. And the band quit here, see? I guess that was the idea--to come out to California and quit. They didn't...they quit...they left here. She was on the Orpheum, I think.

And the members of the Majors and Minors were George Bryant, Addison O'Neil, William Woodman, Eddie Morgan, Adam Mitchell, Fitz Weston, somebody Gordon on piano, and William Robinson, and somebody Bruce on banjo, George Morgan, Lawrence Craig and you, the leader. Is that right?
